content:
Counterpoint Research published its latest report, predicting that global shipments of foldable smartphones will grow 21% year-on-year in 2026, and that Apple will capture 25% market share after entering the market. Details below.

Apple is expected to account for one in every four foldable smartphone shipments globally in 2026

Counterpoint Research's report published this week predicted that Samsung will continue to lead global foldable smartphone shipments in 2026, but its market share will fall from 40% in 2025 to 32%.

Apple is expected to debut in second place with a 25% market share, narrowly leading Huawei's 24%, the latter's share slipping from 30% last year. Motorola is projected to follow with 8%, down from 12% last year, while HONOR's share is expected to fall from 7% to 3%. Other brands combined are expected to take the remaining 8%, down from 11% in 2025.

Counterpoint expects Apple's entry to drive a 21% year-on-year increase in global foldable smartphone shipments in 2026 and to "intensify competition in the high-end book-style foldable market."

Report contents:

The report comes as Samsung has just announced its new generation of foldable phones, headlined by the all-new "passport-style" design of the Galaxy Z Fold8.
